parsed.name: Marconi 203N系列射频信号发生器
parsed.description: Marconi 203N系列是一类台式射频/微波信号发生器，可在约10 kHz到1.35 GHz、2.7 GHz或5.4 GHz范围内输出可调频率与幅度的测试信号，并支持多种调制方式。该类仪器常用于射频电路、通信设备和微波实验中的信号注入、链路测试、接收机校准与一般电子测量。
parsed.description_en: The Marconi 203N series is a benchtop RF/microwave signal generator that provides adjustable-frequency, adjustable-amplitude test signals from about 10 kHz up to 1.35 GHz, 2.7 GHz, or 5.4 GHz depending on model, with support for multiple modulation modes. It is commonly used for signal injection, receiver calibration, communications testing, and general RF/microwave laboratory measurements.
